_meta.description: ILM for agent-logs-* (monthly index agent-logs-YYYY-MM; ADR-0090 telemetry catch-all). min_age-based delete from origination date (no rollover write-alias — the prior rollover action here was dead: agent-logs-template never set index.lifecycle.name, so no index was ever ILM-managed and agent-logs-000001, its rollover-alias bootstrap index, sat at 0 docs). Retention: 30d, unchanged from the prior policy's delete phase and from the elasticsearch_logs RETENTION_POLICIES entry (telemetry/lifecycle.py) whose client-side sweep this same ticket retires. No warm/forcemerge phase: the 32d min_age used elsewhere (matching the user-turn-ratings-policy precedent, so a still-open monthly index isn't merged) is >= this family's own 30d retention -- ES rejects a policy whose warm min_age exceeds its delete min_age (hot must precede warm must precede delete). At only 30 days total lifetime the forcemerge optimization has little value anyway. Authored in FRE-1036, replacing the dead rollover scaffold.
